text:
[NADP.5.1.1] Adapters maintain their own connection
state; libds has no concept of "adapter
disconnected." The adapter:

- On disconnect, **continues to receive callbacks**
  from the engine (rules don't pause when an
  adapter disconnects). The cb returns a `CallError`
  with an `adapter.*` code ([LECC.4.3]) per LCRS.4.2.3 +
  LCRS.10.6 instead of attempting the operation.
  Author rules that expect timely responses use the
  absence idiom ([LCRS.7.1]).
- On reconnect, **re-publish LOGICAL state** the
  source system has (re-fetch all entity states;
  subscribe to retained topics; etc.) so the
  engine's working memory matches the source again. Adapter does this by walking the source's
  current state and asserting facts; engine-side
  no-op-reassertion-dedup absorbs unchanged values.
